2608.30022.title: Automatic Conversion of NICE Guidelines to an Executable Computational Model Using Large Language Models
2608.30022.paper_summary: Introduction: NICE guidelines provide evidence-based recommendations for clinical care but remain largely in unstructured natural language. Existing approaches to converting them into computable representations often focus on individual diseases, require substantial manual encoding, and do not scale. Large language models (LLMs) may enable much of this translation to be automated. Methods: We present an end-to-end approach that converts textual clinical guidelines into executable models capable of generating explainable, patient-specific recommendations. A stepwise LLM-based transformation with in-context examples produces human-inspectable intermediate artifacts. We apply the approach to NICE pancreatic and lung cancer guidelines, use expert review to assess rule alignment, and evaluate the executable pancreatic cancer model on 20 patient vignettes. Results: Expert review showed strong alignment between the source guidelines and generated executable models. Most discrepancies were partial omissions rather than incorrect logic, while hallucinated or fundamentally incorrect rules were rare. On the patient vignettes, the executable model achieved an F1 score of 82.5%. Conclusion: LLMs can transform natural-language NICE guidelines into interpretable, executable models that preserve guideline structure, support transparent inspection and modification, and generate patient-specific recommendations. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of scalable automated generation of computable clinical guidelines.
2608.30022.paper_summary_zh: 引言：NICE 指南提供基於證據的臨床護理建議，但仍然主要以非結構化的自然語言呈現。現有的將其轉換為可計算表示的方法通常集中於單一疾病，需大量手動編碼，且無法擴展。大型語言模型（LLMs）可能使這一翻譯過程的自動化成為可能。方法：我們提出了一種端到端的方法，將文本臨床指南轉換為可執行模型，能夠生成可解釋的、針對患者的具體建議。基於 LLM 的逐步轉換結合上下文示例，產生可供人類檢查的中間產物。我們將此方法應用於 NICE 胰臟癌和肺癌指南，並使用專家評審來評估規則的一致性，對 20 個患者小案例評估可執行的胰臟癌模型。結果：專家評審顯示源指南與生成的可執行模型之間有很強的一致性。大多數差異是部分省略，而非邏輯錯誤，幻覺或根本錯誤的規則則很少。在患者小案例中，可執行模型的 F1 分數達到 82.5%。結論：LLMs 可以將自然語言的 NICE 指南轉換為可解釋的、可執行的模型，保持指南結構，支持透明的檢查和修改，並生成針對患者的具體建議。這些發現展示了可擴展自動生成可計算臨床指南的可行性。
